title: The honeypot fork cases that expect "not safe" can pass for the wrong reason: for V2 modes 1 and 2 and the multi-amount Test 7 the liquidity add itself fails, so the checker returns unsafe because no pool exists, and the V3 contrived case proves only that a token with no V3 pool is unsafe; no fork case shows the checker detecting a V3 honeypot

evidence.note: addLiquidityETH in a try/catch; the comment says modes 1 and 2 revert there and "the wrapper still fails-closed ... (no pool → router reverts → unsafe verdict)"
assertion: verdict not "safe" and three probe results, which a no-pool revert satisfies
V3 contrived case: "No V3 pool exists for HPV3/WETH on the fork", asserts not "safe"
mode-4 LP add caught "expected if threshold is low"
Test 7 uses a 30-token threshold while the LP add transfers 100,000 tokens, so the pool is never created and the not-safe verdict comes from the missing pool, not from the amount-tier probes
comment: "Vitest may run fork test files in parallel" (stale: vitest.config.ts:44 sets fileParallelism false)

sibling_sites_checked: All honeypot fork cases: V2 modes 0 and 3 build a pool (their unsafe verdict is meaningful); honeypotMultiAmount Test 8 asserts "safe" for a permissive threshold (meaningful, the only positive case). The integration honeypot tests (honeypotDispatch, honeypotUnknownFailsClosed) decode scripted reverts and are sound for what they claim.
severity_rationale: S2: the honeypot gate is the buy-side capital control; three of its fork proofs would stay green if the checker contract stopped detecting the pattern, as long as pool creation keeps failing first.
recommendation: Phase 25: assert that the pool exists (getReserves > 0) before calling the checker for each mode, and assert the specific reason (BUY_BAL_ZERO, SELL_ETH_ZERO, AMOUNT_TIER_BLOCKED) instead of "not safe"; create a V3 pool for the V3 contrived token.
affected_cases: V2 mode 1 / V2 mode 2: verdict !== 'safe' when deployed against real Uniswap V2 on fork
Test 7: amountTierThreshold between 1% and 50% probe sizes → 50%+100% probes revert → overall unsafe
exercises simulateViaContractV3 dispatch — verdict !== safe for a Honeypot.sol mode-0 token
escaped_regression: Remove the amount-tier detection from HoneypotChecker.sol: Test 7 stays green because its token never gets a pool and the checker reverts on the missing pool.
